verdict.rationale: The docs describe container tags, static vs dynamic memory flags, and knowledge-graph facts, but nowhere document TTL, expiration dates, or recency-based decay of memories. One comparison note (supermemory-docs-48) even flags 'No temporal truth' — old and new facts staying equally relevant — which is the opposite of automatic staleness suppression. Missing for 10: any TTL/expiration API, explicit decay/recency weighting mechanism, or documentation of automatic deprecation of stale facts.
